problem.title: Minimum Xor Path in A Grid

approaches.title: Hash-set dynamic programming
approaches.summary: Track the set of reachable XOR values at each column, merging values from paths arriving from above and from the left. Return the minimum value reachable at the destination.

revisions.shortChangeSummary: Implements the grid DP using a HashSet of reachable XOR values at each cell.

approaches.title: Boolean-array bitset dynamic programming
approaches.summary: Represent reachable XOR values with a fixed-size Boolean array and update the arrays as the grid DP advances. Later revisions optimize the merge and attempt to pack the representation, but the packed version is marked wrong.

revisions.shortChangeSummary: Replaces HashSets with Boolean-array masks for reachable XOR values.

revisions.rawCommitSubject: rust 3882: reduce cloning and work done
revisions.commitBody:
- more idiomatic overloading of the or operator
- or operation borrows instead of consuming, so no need to clone
- calculate `top or left` first so xor is only called once, so 1 less

revisions.shortChangeSummary: Refactors mask merging to use borrowed bitwise OR and combines the predecessor masks before applying XOR.
